overall_design: Make the Paris hotel reservation dependent on first resolving a fraudulent London AI Summit registration. The Paris Budget Hotel Request email notes the reservation cannot be finalized until Emma verifies the legitimacy of the registration from events@london-ai-summit.org and warns both Sara Lee and Michael Smith. A separate email from Mark Black independently requests the same warning action, and a London AI Summit conference-hotel email reinforces the security concern, all pointing to the target: find the fraudulent registration email and send the urgent warning to the same two CC recipients.

Next-step cue: explicit conditional 'Before we can finalize this Paris hotel reservation…' that compels Emma to search for and act on that registration.
Local role: concise subject for Mark's email to Emma. Use a short, realistic subject like 'Urgent: London AI Summit Registration Issue' to signal the problem. No instructions in the subject.

Local role: footnote in a London AI Summit conference-hotel email.
